The '''jakelian knife-dance''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]] technique taught to the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to help them learn distance, timing, and rhythm.
